text:
Alex H.: heads-up — during the EU reservation warmup window at ~2026-03-10T09:12Z we saw queue_depth spike and batch_size collapse (typical 64 -> 1). Autoscaler overreacted and spun up extra GPUs, we spilled traffic to us-west. Dashboards didn’t show a clean pre-signal, anyone digging into this?

InfraBot: Alert eu-gpu-saturation fired x3 between 2026-03-10T09:12:00Z - 2026-03-10T09:18:00Z. avg_p99_latency > 400ms, queue_depth > 1200. See: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/EU?panelId=123 :rotating_light:

Maya P.: saw it too. Looks correlated with the reservation warmup job that creates a bunch of very short-lived pods. Those pods have empty KV caches, so per-request latency spikes and the batcher emits tiny batches -> util drop -> autoscaler thinks we need more nodes.

Samir: i reproduced the pattern locally and used these promqls to surface it quickly. share in case useful: 

Samir: ```
# 95th batch size over 5m (bucketed metric)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(gpu_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))

# smoothed queue depth (3m avg) by region
sum(avg_over_time(request_queue_depth[3m])) by (region)
```

Jia L.: autoscaler config is part of it. our cooldown is 30s so during a ~2min warmup burst we oscillate. Proposal: use a 5m smoothing window for the target metric (avg_over_time(node_gpu_utilization[5m])) and require a sustained breach before scale-out. instant util -> noise -> thrash.

Priya: dashboard suggestions: add a 'reservation-warmup' annotation stream from the reservation API (emit events when warmups start/end) so panels can overlay warmup windows. also change eu headroom alert to require a sustained condition (for: 4m) before firing — huge reduction in noisy alerts and unnecessary extra capacity. :white_check_mark:

Alex H.: two quick asks: (1) exporters/restart artifacts — sometimes exporter restarts reset some gauges and make headroom look larger for a minute, hiding real risk. what's the best query pattern to avoid being fooled by resets? (2) who can pick up the alert + grafana patch?

Samir: for resets/counters: prefer `increase()` or `rate()` on counters so restarts are handled. for gauges that temporarily spike on exporter startup, use a conservative window with `min_over_time()` or `max_over_time()` depending on what you want to ignore. example snippets: 

Samir: ```
# safe headroom: use 5m min to avoid transient spikes from exporter restart
min_over_time(node_headroom_gauge[5m])

# avoid counting pre-warm tiny batches as normal; 95th batch size smoothed
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(gpu_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))

# autoscaler target suggestion: average utilization over 5m
avg_over_time(node_gpu_utilization[5m])
```

Samir: and change alert rule to include `for: 4m` in the PrometheusRule so short warmups don't trigger scale actions. Example alert condition (pseudo-rule): 

Samir: ```
- alert: EU_GPU_Sustained_Saturation
  expr: sum(avg_over_time(request_queue_depth[3m])) by (region) > 1000
  for: 4m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "EU GPU saturation sustained > 4m"
```

Maya P.: agreed. also log correlation: add a panel that joins reservation API events with request latencies and batch_size histogram so when warmups happen you can zoom and see the chain (reservation -> tiny-batch -> queue -> scale).

Priya: i'll own the grafana patch (annotation stream + panel). can someone open the PR for the alert rule change? tagging @eng-sre.

Jia L.: i can do the rule PR. i'll also tweak the autoscaler policy to use `avg_over_time(node_gpu_utilization[5m])` and push a canary to eu-staging first.

Alex H.: awesome. one last thought — consider adding a pre-warm cache layer for reservation pods (warm a mini KV cache) so their first few requests don't kill batch size. not required for the immediate fix but reduces tail risk and cost.

Samir: noted. created a tiny runbook in the thread for next steps: 1) Priya adds warmup annotation + panel patch, 2) Jia updates alert rule and autoscaler target (5m smoothing + for: 4m), 3) Devs investigate pre-warm cache prototype. anyone object?

Priya: no objections. i'll open the grafana PR today.

Jia L.: opening PR for alert + autoscaler now. wont be long.

Alex H.: thanks everyone. please ping here with PR links and I'll coordinate post-deploy validation (look at batch size 95p and queue depth for 30m after deploy). :pray:
